The [[Separatist Droid Army]] utilized a passenger '''airspeeder''' during the [[Clone Wars]]. An [[airspeeder]] was used by a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Anaxes)|T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes]], but was later stolen by "[[Crosshair]]" as a getaway vehicle for the [[Clone Captain]] "[[Rex]]," [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Jesse|CT-5597]] "Jesse," and [[Clone Force 99]] after they infiltrated the [[Cyber Center]] on [[Anaxes]].<ref name="Bad Batch" />
